properties.description: Rocky (1976), directed by John G. Avildsen and written by and starring Sylvester Stallone, is a drama about a small‑time Philadelphia boxer who gets an unlikely shot at the world heavyweight title. Co‑starring Talia Shire, Burt Young, Carl Weathers and Burgess Meredith, the film blends a boxing‑centered sports plot with a tender romantic subplot and mentor/mentee relationships. Its themes of perseverance, dignity, and the underdog's struggle are delivered through intimate, gritty filmmaking and an uplifting emotional tone. The movie helped popularize a modest, street‑level aesthetic and iconic training sequences.

properties.description: Rocky (2021), directed by Arun Matheswaran and starring Bharathiraja, Raveena Ravi, and Vasanth Ravi, is a gritty action-drama rooted in gangster cinema. After a 17-year prison term the protagonist returns home to search for his missing sister, and the film unfolds as a brutal, flashback-laden exploration of trauma, memory, and revenge. Noted for its intense fight sequences, stark cinematography, and raw emotional register, the film emphasizes character-driven moral conflict and visceral violence.

short_descriptions.value: A gangster, freed after 17 years, returns to his childhood home to find his missing sister while his violent past resurfaces.
Ein Gangster, nach 17 Jahren frei, kehrt in sein Elternhaus zurück, um seine verschwundene Schwester zu suchen, während seine gewalttätige Vergangenheit wieder auftaucht.
Un gánster, liberado tras 17 años, regresa a su hogar de la infancia para buscar a su hermana desaparecida mientras su violento pasado resurge.
Un gangster, libéré après 17 ans, revient dans sa maison d'enfance pour retrouver sa sœur disparue tandis que son passé violent refait surface.

properties.description: Rocky (2019), directed by Adnan A. Shaikh, is an Indian Marathi-language action drama with romantic elements starring Shibani Akthar, Rahul Dev, and Akshaya Hindalkar. The film follows an ordinary young man whose life is overturned by violent circumstances and who becomes a deliverer of vengeance. Through its action set pieces and interpersonal conflicts the narrative examines justice, moral compromise, and personal transformation. The overall tone is tense and gritty, aiming for visceral emotional catharsis.

short_descriptions.value: An ordinary man’s life is upended by violence, driving him to seek revenge and become a relentless avenger while his relationships and morals unravel.
Das Leben eines gewöhnlichen Mannes wird durch Gewalt zerstört; er sucht Rache und wird zum unerbittlichen Rächer, während seine Beziehungen und seine Moral zerfallen.
La vida de un hombre corriente cambia por la violencia, llevándole a buscar venganza y convertirse en un implacable ajusticiador mientras sus relaciones y su moral se desmoronan.
La vie d’un homme ordinaire bascule après un acte de violence, le poussant à la vengeance et à devenir un vengeur implacable tandis que ses liens et sa morale s’effritent.

properties.description: Rocky II (1979), written and directed by Sylvester Stallone, continues the saga of Rocky Balboa as he and his loved ones cope with the aftermath of a championship bout. Starring Sylvester Stallone, Talia Shire and Burt Young, the sports drama follows Rocky’s struggle with family responsibilities, medical worries, and the champion who goads him into a rematch. The film emphasizes perseverance, loyalty and working-class pressures while balancing tense ring action with quiet domestic moments to achieve an uplifting emotional payoff.

properties.description: Rocky IV (1985), written and directed by Sylvester Stallone and starring Sylvester Stallone, Talia Shire and Burt Young, is a sports drama about a world heavyweight champion who must confront a towering Soviet challenger after his friend is killed in the ring. The film blends Cold War–tinged nationalism and personal redemption with extended, music-heavy training montages and a climactic rematch. Noted for its soundtrack and stylized action, it emphasizes themes of friendship, grief, perseverance and revenge.
